integrity: All formulas follow from a necessary-and-sufficient product-fiber classification. Packaged exact checker compares triple-rank distributions through degree seven. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact all-degree formulas concern ordered commuting pairs of total regressive idempotents only; no asymptotic or larger-family results. General proof is bijective, with finite checks only as corroboration. The full text of the directly relevant 2024 D_n article could not be inspected; publication priority is not established exhaustively.
title: Joint image-rank census of commuting idempotents in the regressive transformation monoid
